values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/shupaclake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Shupac Lake State Forest Campground, Crawford: rustic, seasonal closure 'open all year', managed by Hartwick Pines SP 989-348-7068, 30 sites, $20, ORV operation between SFCG and trails allowed no, reservable no), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/shupaclake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/shupaclake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 30 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard wording; no length posted).

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/shupaclake ('There are 30 sites for tent and small trailer use'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (30 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic AuSable State Forest campground among hardwoods along the shore of Shupac Lake, 3 mi N of Lovells via Twin Bridge Road and Campground Trail. Boat launch and carry-in access in the campground; clear lake good for fishing and paddling (panfish), with the North Branch Au Sable River half a mile west. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 30 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual); 'tent and small trailer use' is the standard SFC wording (silent on length). Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian or an ORV camp (ORV operation 'no'). Directions carry no road warning. Note trimmed of field restatements.
